title: Capability Manifest (ai-manifest.yaml)
description: Consumer-side dependency declaration: which capability-registry plugins this repo consumes, its universe, and per-surface hints. Resolved by scripts/ai-resolve.py.

universe.description: Universe id this repo belongs to (manolii | buro | impaktful | cpdcheck, or any value — unregistered repos may still require platform/* and local scopes). Fail-closed: a repo can never require another universe's scope.

ref.description: Version constraint: exact semver ('1.14.0'), caret range ('^1.14'), tag ('tag:v1.15.0'), or commit pin ('sha:<hex>'). sha: pins resolve at the fetch layer.

feature_flags.description: Optional per-repo toggles a plugin may consult (e.g. kl_integration). Keys are plugin-defined.

surfaces.description: Agent surfaces to materialise for. claude-code is implemented today; others are advisory until their renderers land.
